label: What the solver computes
subgoals: Sum the currents of all taps beyond each segment
Multiply each segment current by its resistance
Add the segment drops from the pad to the tap

label: Errors in the worst drop
subgoals: Find the true worst drop and the predicted worst drop
Divide their absolute difference by the true worst
Check whether both maxima occur on the same tile

label: Hotspot recall
subgoals: Mark the tiles whose true drop exceeds the threshold
Count how many of them the prediction also places above it
Divide by the number of true hotspots
